title: Tami N Probable NDE 5152
content: As I was driving my motorcycle to work one morning, a car did a U-turn and hit me. At sixty mph, I hit the road with no helmet on. I died right away from the accident. An emergency room doctor saw it happen, worked on me, and got me to the trauma center in the hospital. I broke all the bones on my right side, and seriously injured my head. The left side of my brain was separated from the right. I died three more times at the hospital. I was on life support and in a coma for two months. When I woke up, I didn't know how I had gotten there, and couldn't even remember my name. I couldn't walk, talk, or see, and I lost all my memory from before the accident. I did remember who talked to me, and around me, while I was in the coma. The first day, a good friend came and begged me to live, but after that, my family wouldn't let me have any visitors. But they couldn't stop my old boss from visiting me. He had died five years before of cancer, and I had helped him at that time. He came and sat with me on my bed while I was in the coma. The room looked bare, but not dark, and we sat and talked about work and hunting off and on for a couple of months. At that point, he told me it was time for me to wake up and go back to work, that I had slept long enough. I woke up, and after a few months, I did learn how to walk, and talk again, and got my vision back. It took a few months more to get most of my memory back. I know there must be a reason for this.

arrival.other_being_detail: Her old boss (deceased five years earlier) visited and sat with her on the bed while she was in a coma.

environment.environment_other_detail: “The room looked bare, but not dark.”

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Deceased boss told her it was time to wake up and go back to work; “you had slept long enough.”
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Implied directive to wake up and return to life/work.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motorcycle crash after a car made a U-turn and hit her; no helmet; ~60 mph impact.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Deceased boss visited repeatedly during coma; conversation; told her to wake up.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience is described as occurring during coma with repeated visits rather than a classic OBE/tunnel/light sequence.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated visits/conversations with deceased boss “off and on for a couple of months.”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Extended, repeated interaction with a deceased boss while in a coma over “a couple of months,” in a bare (not dark) room setting.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “He had died five years before of cancer… He came and sat with me on my bed while I was in the coma.” / “The room looked bare, but not dark…” / “it was time for me to wake up and go back to work, that I had slept long enough.”
